name: Aatmaj Healthcare Ltd.
summary: Aatmaj Healthcare Ltd. is an India-based company operating within the Hospital and Healthcare Services industry, primarily offering multi-specialty healthcare services. The company provides a range of tertiary care, including cardiology, orthopedics, obstetrics & gynecology, critical care, neurology, neurosurgery, nephrology, and various diagnostic and surgical interventions through its multidisciplinary private hospitals and clinics. Aatmaj Healthcare primarily serves the Gujarat region and has expanded its operational footprint to Madhya Pradesh, targeting underserved healthcare markets and offering affordable multi-specialty care to the middle-income demographic. It operates facilities such as Jupiter Hospital in Vadodara and a group of JTP Hospitals, and is NABH accredited. The company focuses on both in-patient and out-patient department services, with plans for increasing bed capacity and expanding into new clinical departments like oncology and dialysis, alongside implementing digital health solutions such as telehealth.
